name: Higashishirakawa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Higashishirakawa village emblem in white: a winged ring enclosing a small disc.
history: Municipal flag of Higashishirakawa, a village in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 23 November 1967.

features.role: Higashishirakawa village emblem — a winged ring enclosing a small disc
